# K-M

Another name for KM.

## Syntax

```text
K-M time [BY factor] /STATUS=var [EVENT](values) [/subcommands of KM].
```

The same command as KM, with the same subcommands and defaults.

## Example

```text
K-M days_to_repair /STATUS=fixed(1).
```

`statscraft help K-M` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
